item: Enforce the format loop: bro init --pre-commit, a Stop hook in the plugin
notes: docs/proposals/agents-in-consumer-repos.md, section 4: the AGENTS.md section and the skill describe the loop but nothing enforces it. bro init --pre-commit [plain|lefthook|husky] writes pre-commit.md's tested hook (every agent and person); the Claude Code plugin gets a Stop hook running bro check --files on the changed C# files. Only with the flag, like --agents-md (to decide).
